baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive رَبَّهُ, temporal كَانَ, and person-directed بِهِ بَصِيرًا form one continuous Lord-person relation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Lordship places the person within an owned and governed relation; temporal predication makes sight already present; outer and inner sight make that presence cognitively complete. The clause therefore denies that the person was ever outside notice or that knowledge begins only when consequences arrive.

activation_trace.role: Lordship, ownership, and authority make the possessive relation a standing jurisdiction rather than a generic observer-subject link.
Being and temporal predication make the seeing an already-present state, not information acquired later.
Direct sight preserves the clause's concrete register of nothing escaping view.
Inner sight extends seeing to knowledge, verification, and the person's own self-witness.

changed_reading.before: A superior observer sees the person at some relevant moment.
changed_reading.after: His own Lord's sight and knowledge have already accompanied him as an unbroken governing relation; reckoning cannot inform this Lord of anything new.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَبَّهُ can activate care and completion, while كَانَ بِهِ بَصِيرًا places discerning attention inside that enduring relation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Lord is not only an owner but one who repairs, nurtures, and brings a dependent through stages. The surety-like branch of being adds undertaken responsibility, and inner sight supplies the discrimination needed for such care. Seeing can therefore be participatory supervision rather than detached surveillance.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion turn lordship into stage-by-stage formative care.
Suretyship and undertaking responsibility supply a custodial, though form-distant, shade to the enduring relation.
Penetrating knowledge provides the discernment by which nurture can track an interior condition.

changed_reading.before: The clause offers passive surveillance as a reason for accountability.
changed_reading.after: The clause also allows an ongoing custodial gaze: the one who governs and completes the person has discerned every stage from within the same relation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object بِهِ directs بَصِيرًا at this person, while the inner-sight branch explicitly includes self-witness.
baseline_models.mechanism: Seeing reaches beyond an external profile into knowledge and verification, including evidence the person bears against or about himself. The Lord-person relation holds both outside observation and inward self-disclosure without reducing one to the other.

activation_trace.role: Personal lordship makes the inward evidence answerable to the same one who owns and governs the person.
Temporal presence prevents inward evidence from being treated as a late discovery.
Inner sight, verification, and self-witness make the person himself a site of evidence.

changed_reading.before: The person is merely an object under an external gaze.
changed_reading.after: He is known through to the inward evidence he carries; divine sight and eventual self-disclosure can be two aspects of one evidentiary relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The cosmic surfaces do not merely break: they answer their Lord, become due to do so, and transfer what was inside to the outside until emptied. This turns the focus sight into a jurisdiction of exposure. What lies under lordship can be made to answer by yielding its contents, so being seen is materially paired with becoming manifest.

activation_trace.role: A formerly continuous surface splits open, supplying the first operation of exposure.
Listening and accepting make cosmic matter responsive to lordly address rather than inert scenery.
Fixed obligation and due-ness turn response into answerability rather than optional disclosure.
Casting a thing out supplies the transfer from concealed interior to exposed exterior.
Stripping and emptying complete the removal of a concealing interior.
The focus Lord-person relation anchors cosmic answerability back to the person rather than leaving it as an independent theme.
Concrete sight is changed by the context from observation of a surface to assured access when surfaces open.

structural_cues: 84:1-5 alternates sky and earth and repeats their answering of their Lord.
84:4 coordinates casting out what is inside with becoming empty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opened surfaces, accepted address, due response, ejection, and emptying. I supply the arrow that lordly seeing is the relation under which interiors become answerable; a live alternative is that the cosmic sequence only stages judgment and leaves seeing purely epistemic.

changed_reading.before: The Lord observes a person whose interior may remain merely private.
changed_reading.after: The person stands within a lordly field that can open coverings and require contents to answer; 'seeing him' carries the latent certainty of exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Arduous striving is also an abrasion that leaves a mark, and the movement is directed toward encounter. The focus sight can therefore preserve the worked path in its traces: the Lord does not inspect only an endpoint but sees how the person was marked while moving toward Him.

activation_trace.role: Toil and action with hardship supply the sustained human process being seen.
A scratch or bite-mark turns arduous action into residue legible on the traveler.
Two things coming face to face gives the marked path a directed terminus in encounter.
Stage-by-stage care keeps the travel process inside the Lord relation rather than reducing it to a final inspection.
The branch of a visible blood trace makes even a small bodily residue evidentiary, while remaining an exploratory activation of بَصِيرًا.

structural_cues: 84:6 repeats كَادِحٌ and كَدْحًا around the directional phrase إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ.
The result clause فَمُلَاقِيهِ makes encounter the terminus of the toil.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arduous work, scratch-like trace, and face-to-face encounter. I supply the arrow that sight preserves each abrasion as path evidence; the live alternative is that sight grounds only a final audit and the scratch branch adds no semantic force.

changed_reading.before: The Lord sees the completed life presented at encounter.
changed_reading.after: The Lord has seen the whole laboring approach, including the marks by which the path wrote itself onto the person before encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: A written record fixes what incurs judgment, while accounting counts and examines it. Since the focus says the Lord already was seeing the person, the record need not function as new information for the knower; it externalizes into an assessable form what continuous sight already encompassed.

activation_trace.role: A fixing that makes judgment or decree binding turns seen life into durable adjudicable record.
Enrollment in a register makes the record personally indexed even when received in an inverted posture.
Counting and calculation supply the explicit conversion of recorded material into account.
Deliberate examination makes accounting qualitative inquiry as well as arithmetic.
Prior temporal presence places divine knowledge before the later presentation of the record.
Knowledge and verification make sight the epistemic ground of the record and account.

structural_cues: 84:7 and 84:10 mirror the receipt of the same personal book in right-side and behind-the-back positions.
The easy account in 84:8 immediately follows receipt of the book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies binding record, registration, counting, and examination. I supply the arrow that continuous sight underwrites rather than learns from the record; a live alternative is that the record serves the person or court while its relation to seeing remains unstated.

changed_reading.before: The Lord's seeing is general omniscience adjacent to a later accounting scene.
changed_reading.after: Continuous sight is the prior evidentiary ground from which a life can be fixed, personally indexed, and rendered into account without any epistemic gap.

context_deltas.mechanism: The failed recipient's book is placed behind his back. The branches turn that posture into a concealment geometry: something is put behind appearance and front is reversed with interior. Against this geometry, بِهِ بَصِيرًا means there is no protective 'behind' relative to divine sight.

activation_trace.role: Covering a thing by placing it behind what appears supplies an active concealment operation.
Turning a matter back-to-belly supplies inversion between exposed face and concealed interior.
The back of the unseen and the heart links bodily rearwardness to inaccessible inward knowledge.
Direct sight supplies the orientation that the behind-the-back posture attempts to defeat.
Inner sight cancels the distinction between visible front and hidden inward side.

structural_cues: 84:10 locates the book specifically وَرَاءَ ظَهْرِهِ rather than merely in the left hand.
The focus repeats the same attached pronoun in رَبَّهُ, بِهِ, keeping the concealment geometry personal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hiding-behind and front/interior inversion. I supply the arrow that the posture attempts concealment and that sight defeats its geometry; the live alternative is that receiving behind the back signifies humiliation without any attempted hiding.

changed_reading.before: The Lord sees whatever happens to be presented before Him.
changed_reading.after: Neither bodily orientation nor the reversal of surface and interior creates a rear side to divine sight; what is put behind the self remains fully before the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same outward state of joy occurs once after easy account and once inside the life that denies return. The branches expose joy as inward and potentially concealed, while conjecture and return disclose the second joy's hidden horizon. Divine inner sight discriminates between affectively identical surfaces by seeing the orientation nested inside them.

activation_trace.role: Hidden joy supplies the first affective state, here following account and return to family.
Concealment in the interior makes the second joy capable of sheltering an unseen self-story.
The repeated hidden joy makes the two lives look affectively alike before their orientations are distinguished.
Conjecture and imagining supply the inward judgment nested behind the second joy.
Return supplies the denied trajectory that differentiates the two otherwise similar family joys.
Inner sight penetrates the affective surface to verify the belief and trajectory carried within it.

structural_cues: مَسْرُورًا closes both 84:9 and 84:13, but the first follows account while the second precedes denial of return.
The focus begins بَلَى immediately after the denied return, correcting an inward forecast rather than an observable movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated hidden joy, conjecture, and denied return. I supply the diagnostic arrow from the second joy to a self-sealing story about no return; a live alternative is that joy and denial are adjacent features with no causal relation.

changed_reading.before: Seeing distinguishes people mainly by visible action and outcome.
changed_reading.after: The Lord sees the eschatological orientation inside an outwardly ordinary joy, distinguishing two identical affective surfaces by what each joy quietly expects.

context_deltas.mechanism: Twilight passes into darkness that gathers, the moon becomes complete and coherent, and the human mounts state after state. The focus roots then interact unusually well: lordship nurtures by stages, being remains present in time, and inner sight gathers successive layers into knowledge of one person. Seeing is phase-integrating, not a snapshot.

activation_trace.role: The red afterglow marks a threshold state rather than a stable endpoint.
Night and darkness supply a phase in which ordinary optical access is reduced.
Gathering scattered things makes the dark phase an operation of collection rather than mere absence of light.
Completion and coherence give the gathered sequence an integrated form.
Moonlight returns visibility within darkness while retaining the temporal phase sequence.
One thing layered over another gives human transition a cumulative vertical structure.
State after state explicitly converts layering into temporal succession.
Nurture stage by stage anchors the phase sequence in the focus Lord relation.
Temporal presence keeps sight continuous while the observed state changes.
Inner sight can know the continuity joining phases even when surface visibility and condition alter.

structural_cues: The oath sequence moves from twilight to gathering night to the moon's completion.
84:19 transfers that phased structure to the addressee with emphatic لَتَرْكَبُنَّ and repeated طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies threshold light, darkness, gathering, completion, layering, and state-after-state succession. I supply the analogical arrow that divine sight integrates the person's phases into one trajectory; a live alternative is that the oaths prove transition without specifying how the Lord sees it.

changed_reading.before: The Lord sees the person as a stable object at a decisive instant.
changed_reading.after: The Lord sees one identity through every gathered and superimposed phase, retaining the coherence of the whole trajectory when no single state displays it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covering and denial are followed by divine knowing of what people gather inside. The heart and vessel branches make the person a container of meaning, while disclosure to the knower makes that container transparent. The focus sight now knows both the stored content and the operation by which truth is covered.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the act that attempts to place truth beneath an opaque layer.
Attributing falsehood makes concealment an active verdict against what is presented.
Disclosure of the thing to the knower directly reverses the attempted covering.
Holding meaning in the heart locates the relevant contents inside the person.
Putting a thing in a vessel gives inward accumulation a concrete container model.
Inner sight and verification make the heart-container transparent without flattening it into visible behavior.

structural_cues: 84:20-23 moves from refusal of faith and prostration to covering, denial, and finally what is held within.
84:23 repeats the focus construction of divine cognition directed بِمَا at concealed content.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, denial, disclosure to knowledge, and heart or vessel containment. I supply the arrow that these form a concealment strategy read by sight; a live alternative is that يُوعُونَ denotes accumulated deeds rather than hidden meanings or motives.

changed_reading.before: The Lord sees denial as an outward act.
changed_reading.after: The Lord sees through the person's covering operation into what the heart-vessel stores, so concealment itself and concealed content are simultaneously known.

context_deltas.mechanism: Trust, intended work, fitness, recompense, and non-interruption form a positive correspondence. Activated by the focus branches of covenant and surety, seeing becomes more than prosecutorial surveillance: it is the competent witness that no fitting work disappears and that its recompense is not severed.

activation_trace.role: Security and settled trust supply the relational posture opposite defensive concealment.
Intended action supplies the human contribution whose persistence must be witnessed.
Fitness and suitability make the action correspond to its proper end rather than merely occur.
Recompense for work supplies the answering return to the witnessed action.
Cutting and diminishing define by negation the reward's uninterrupted extension.
Covenant and pact activate a binding relational frame within the focus term for Lord.
Suretyship gives enduring being a guarantor-like shade, retained as a branch activation rather than a direct gloss of كَانَ.
Verified knowledge makes the Lord's witness sufficient to preserve the work-recompense correspondence.

structural_cues: 84:25 is an exception after the sequence of denial and painful consequence, so the same divine cognition opens onto a positive outcome.
The clause pairs faith and fitting work with a recompense explicitly negated as cut off.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trust, intended work, suitability, recompense, and non-cutting; focus branches supply covenant and surety. I supply the arrow that divine sight guarantees the correspondence; a live alternative is that promise alone guarantees reward and seeing remains only evidentiary.

changed_reading.before: Being seen chiefly threatens the denier with inescapable prosecution.
changed_reading.after: The same unbroken sight can protect fitting labor from loss, acting as covenantal witness that its answering recompense will not be cut off.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because an axis is supplied by a distant branch of ح و ر and sight does not lexically mean gravitational or rotational force. It remains anchored in the focus Lord-person relation, the enduring branches of ر ب ب and ك و ن, and the immediate correction of denied return. Downstream prose should render it only as a spatial analogy: apparent departure may still be motion within an inescapable field of regard.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رَبَّهُ ... كَانَ بِهِ بَصِيرًا keeps the person in an enduring relation precisely where the preceding proposition denies that he will return.

activation_trace.role: Return and diminution supply the overt motion denied immediately before the focus.
Rotation around an axis supplies the exploratory geometry in which motion away remains bounded motion.
Staying, clinging, and lasting make the Lord relation spatially and temporally persistent.
Continuous temporal predication prevents an interval outside that persistent relation.
Inner sight supplies the encompassing field that the axis analogy spatializes.

changed_reading.before: The person imagines a one-way departure with no return.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, his Lord's enduring sight behaves like the axis of his motion: what feels like departure never exits the relation and therefore can curve into return.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it activates the seam branch of ب ص ر and the bone-setting branches as material analogies, not ordinary glosses of بَصِيرًا. It remains anchored in both focus roots, where lordship includes repair and sight includes joining an edge, and is reinforced by the packet's split, healed fracture, fitness, and straightening images. Downstream prose should qualify it as a reparative image of discernment, never as a lexical substitution for 'seeing.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines a Lord branch of repair and completion with a sight branch describing the joined edge between two panels.

activation_trace.role: Splitting and opening supply the rupture whose edges later become available for reparative comparison.
A bone knitting after fracture supplies a concrete image of restored continuity.
Suitability and fit supply the criterion by which separated parts can correspond.
Setting a fracture despite crookedness supplies the corrective action that follows discerned fit.
Repair, nurture, and completion anchor the reparative direction in the focus Lord term.
The thick joined edge between two panels supplies the seam image through which sight becomes discernment of how ruptures fit.

changed_reading.before: The Lord's sight detects rupture and assigns its consequence.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, lordly sight can also discern matching edges and the fit by which a fractured life is repaired rather than merely exposed.

strongest_changes: Cosmic opening and emptying changed sight from passive observation into answerable exposure under lordship.
Toil, abrasion, and encounter changed sight from endpoint inspection into preservation of a marked path.
Twilight, gathering night, completed moon, and layered states changed sight from a snapshot into phase-integrating knowledge.
Covering and inward containment changed sight into knowledge of both concealed contents and the act of concealment.
The final trust-work-recompense sequence preserved a positive reading in which continuous sight guarantees that fitting labor is not lost.
summary.what_was_special: The focus clause could carry several live relations at once: jurisdiction, nurture, evidence, inward witness, and guarantee. The context did not collapse them into generic omniscience; it supplied material operations of opening, marking, recording, reversing, gathering, containing, and repairing that changed how 'seeing him' functions.
remaining_uncertainties: كَانَ may mark ordinary past predication rather than the full continuity assigned to it here.
The causal move from divine sight to exposure, record, or guarantee is abductive; the packet can also support sight as knowledge accompanying independently caused events.
يُوعُونَ may concern accumulated deeds rather than inward motives, leaving the heart-container reading underdetermined.
The blood-trace, axial-return, surety, and reparative-seam activations are branch-distant and should remain explicitly exploratory.
